result.detail: No simulator was run by me; the platform's simulator.run evidence requirement must still be met, followed by an independent review. The PRNG is written in the testbench so the stimulus is the same on Icarus and Verilator. No SystemVerilog-only constructs are used. The table model and the bitwise model are both written from the spec, and any disagreement between them counts as a failure. Because they share one reading of the spec, the hand-computed known answers serve as the independent anchor. To replay a run with different stimulus, rerun with +seed=<n>.
